senses.gloss: f. (preced.) = h. נָפָה, fan, winnow, sieve.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 111b:8">Pes. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>והדר ביה כנ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>כינוֹפָא</he>) and he moves to and fro like a fan.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 97b:9">B. Kam. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ כי נ׳</he> (Ms. R. <he>מנפיא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80) even if the new coin be of the size of a sieve?; <cite ref="Chullin 124a">Ḥull. 124ᵃ</cite> <he>אפי׳ כנ׳</he> even if the flesh on the hide be of the size &c.?—
<cite ref="Gittin 69a:12">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>פארי דריש נ׳</he> the bran which comes up to the top of the sieve when shaken.—

<cite ref="Chullin 45a:7">Ḥull. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>וסימניך נ׳</he> to remember the process required to ascertain the condition of the trachea perforated like a sieve, think of the construction of a sieve; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="N01020"><he>נַפְוָותָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="N01020"><he>נִפְוָותָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 74a:8">B. Mets. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>איפשר בנ׳</he> the winnowing may be done with a fan (independently of the wind).
<cite ref="Sukkah 20b:5">Succ. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>חזו לפרסי ונ׳</he> can be used for covers and sieves, v. <cite ref="Q01914"><he>פְּרָסָא</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:45">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᶜ</cite> top <he>נָפָן</he> (fr. <cite ref="N01017"><he>נָפָא</he></cite>).—[<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 3:27">Tosef. Ḥull. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 4:27">IV</cite>), 27 <cite ref="N01038"><he>נפיא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="A02680"><he>אַפְיָין</he></cite>.]
